facts.heading: Anxiety worsened since September
facts.content: Hannah feels anxious all the time, and this anxiety has worsened since September.
facts.evidence: I think I'm just anxious all the time, and it's got worse since September.

facts.heading: Became deputy head at school
facts.content: Hannah was made deputy head at her school in September.
facts.evidence: I was made deputy head at my school.

facts.heading: Taught Year 4 for eleven years
facts.content: Hannah taught Year 4 for eleven years.
facts.evidence: I've taught Year 4 for eleven years

facts.heading: Worries about competence in role
facts.content: Hannah worries that people picked the wrong person for her role and that she will be noticed for not knowing what she is doing.
facts.evidence: I keep thinking they picked the wrong person, and that sooner or later someone will notice I have no idea what I'm doing.

facts.heading: Anxiety peaks on Sunday evenings
facts.content: Hannah's chest gets tight and she starts rehearsing Monday's staff meeting on Sunday evenings.
facts.evidence: Mostly Sunday evenings. My chest goes tight and I start rehearsing Monday's staff meeting in my head.

facts.heading: Rehearses staff meeting scenarios
facts.content: Hannah rehearses every possible question someone might ask during the staff meeting and what she would say.
facts.evidence: Every possible question someone might ask, and what I'd say.

facts.heading: Fears negative perception from colleagues
facts.content: Hannah imagines what colleagues would think of her if she got something wrong.
facts.evidence: Then what they'd think of me if I got it wrong.

facts.heading: Fears being out of depth
facts.content: Hannah imagines that people think she is out of her depth and that the job was given to a teacher who cannot lead.
facts.evidence: That I'm out of my depth. That they gave the job to a nice Year 4 teacher who can't actually lead.

facts.heading: Rewrote email to governors four times
facts.content: Hannah rewrote the same email to the governors four times last week.
facts.evidence: Last week I rewrote the same email to the governors four times.

facts.heading: Email concerned behaviour policy change
facts.content: The email Hannah rewrote was about a change to the behaviour policy.
facts.evidence: A change to the behaviour policy.

facts.heading: Fears Mr Hargreaves' judgment
facts.content: Hannah was afraid Mr Hargreaves, the chair of governors, would think she was stupid regarding the email.
facts.evidence: I was afraid Mr Hargreaves, the chair of governors, would think I was stupid.

facts.heading: Mr Hargreaves has been kind
facts.content: Mr Hargreaves has been kind to Hannah.
facts.evidence: He's been nothing but kind.

facts.heading: Feels like lying to Mr Hargreaves
facts.content: Hannah feels like she is lying to Mr Hargreaves about being capable.
facts.evidence: I feel I'm lying to him.

facts.heading: Feels like pretending to be capable
facts.content: Hannah feels as if she is pretending to be someone who knows what she is doing.
facts.evidence: As if I'm pretending.

facts.heading: Compares self to mother's role
facts.content: Hannah feels like a child wearing her mother's coat.
facts.evidence: Most days I feel like a child wearing her mother's coat.

facts.heading: Mother was a headteacher
facts.content: Hannah's mother was a headteacher for twenty years.
facts.evidence: She was a headteacher for twenty years.

facts.heading: Mother retired six years ago
facts.content: Hannah's mother retired six years ago.
facts.evidence: She retired six years ago

facts.heading: Compares her work to mother's
facts.content: Hannah thinks everything she does would her mother have done better.
facts.evidence: Everything I do, I think, would she have done it better?

facts.heading: Mother is supportive but dismissive
facts.content: Hannah's mother says she has always worried too much and should stop being silly.
facts.evidence: She says I've always worried too much and I should stop being silly.

facts.heading: Feels like making a fuss to mother
facts.content: Hannah feels that her mother's comment makes her feel like she is making a fuss.
facts.evidence: It makes me feel I'm making a fuss.

facts.heading: Waking at 4 AM daily
facts.content: Hannah is awake at four every morning.
facts.evidence: I'm awake at four every morning

facts.heading: Worries keep her awake
facts.content: Hannah goes through her to-do list when she is awake at four AM.
facts.evidence: going through the to-do list

facts.heading: List includes various concerns
facts.content: Hannah's to-do list includes timetable changes, Ofsted prep, a parent complaint, and a worried child.
facts.evidence: Timetable changes, the Ofsted prep, a parent complaint, a child I'm worried about

facts.heading: Waking started in second week of term
facts.content: Hannah has been waking like this since about the second week of term.
facts.evidence: Since about the second week of term

facts.heading: Consumes five or six cups of coffee
facts.content: Hannah drinks five or six cups of coffee to get through the day.
facts.evidence: Five or six

facts.heading: Experiences afternoon physical symptoms

facts.evidence: My heart goes fast. My hands are a bit shaky

facts.evidence: Last Thursday I had to leave a meeting to splash my face with water

facts.evidence: My partner Ben knows a bit

facts.heading: Feels guilty and alone

facts.evidence: Guilty, and a bit alone

facts.evidence: Now I'm their line manager and it's awkward

facts.heading: Misses children and class
facts.content: Hannah misses the children and her class.

facts.evidence: I said yes in the room because I couldn't say no to her. The head

facts.evidence: Then I went home and cried

facts.evidence: Fear, I think. And that I'd never get to go back

facts.evidence: The summer holidays. We went walking in the Lakes

facts.evidence: I started writing down what went well each evening.

facts.content: Hannah stopped writing down positives because she felt silly.

facts.evidence: I'd like to do the job without feeling like a fraud.

facts.evidence: Walking into a meeting and not rehearsing it first.

facts.heading: Goal: send one email

facts.heading: Goal: no stomach knots Sunday
